implemented_contracts: DocumentSource is a final immutable value object carrying sourceId, normalized absolute URI, explicit DocumentFormat, AllowedRoot, defensive content bytes and content digest
AllowedRoot freezes the provider-validated root and performs normalized scheme, authority and path-segment boundary checks
CanonicalDocumentNode freezes name, sorted attributes, Optional scalar, ordered children, SourceRef, format and schema version without parser implementation types
FrontendResult exposes FrontendStatus, Optional Canonical root and immutable diagnostics
FrontendResults PARSED carries exactly one Canonical root and no ERROR while FAILED carries no Canonical root and at least one ERROR
SourceResolutionResults RESOLVED carries non-empty sorted sources and no ERROR while FAILED carries no source candidates and at least one ERROR
Provider to DocumentSource.format to FrontendRegistry to FrontendResult.canonicalRoot compiles and executes through frozen public contracts
